failure_analysis: No hidden case failed across trials; all three candidates passed all 8 frozen expectations. The rendered docs did well on the exact decision points this task required: the Tag Processor overview says to use this class for flat, byte-preserving attribute edits; the usage section documents linear next_tag() scanning; the custom-query/get_attribute discussion explicitly distinguishes null for absent attributes from empty string and true for present attributes; the attribute-modification section says set_attribute() overwrites existing values; and get_updated_html() is documented as preserving every untouched byte. The main near-miss was explanatory only: candidates did not mention incomplete input, but the chosen Tag Processor loop still follows the documented behavior by only modifying complete matched tags and returning the original incomplete bytes untouched.
